name: manual_91ee41
claim: In regexes that validate protocol text use [0-9] or an ASCII flag, never the digit class, and convert parser exceptions (TypeError, ValueError) into the classified wire error at the boundary on both sides of the protocol.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: an audit found Python's digit class accepting fullwidth numerals in timestamps and raw TypeError or ValueError leaking from an unhashable kind or NaN, identically in the issuer and the consumer.
